ideas.title: Investigating Fraud in the Medical Transportation Industry
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of fraud and corruption in the medical transportation industry, including the recent allegations against a national business.
questions: What is the extent of fraud and corruption in the medical transportation industry?
How can the industry be reformed to prevent future instances of fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in the medical transportation industry. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the issue and to identify potential solutions.

ideas.title: Examining Discrimination Against Somali-Owned Businesses in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of discrimination against Somali-owned businesses in Minnesota, including the recent contract cancellation of a Somali-owned transportation company.
questions: What is the extent of discrimination against Somali-owned businesses in Minnesota?
How can the state and local governments work to prevent future instances of discrimination?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to shed light on a important social justice issue in Minnesota. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the issue and to identify potential solutions.
